items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I'd like to say it right now because Melvin was featured on both sessions. We did two sessions for Hammond in 1939

ctx.x: Well, you know, you told me a story earlier, and I'd like--now I think would be the appropriate time, how Willard and John Hammond got in touch with you. You see we talked about that but it's not on the tape.

To backtrack a little, it all came about before we went into New York, naturally Hammond had discovered Basie and I think he carried Harlan Leonard in New York City, a band out of Kansas City, and what's this trumpet player out of Kansas City--all of them had good bands but they just didn't click or something. Well, Hammond was still trying to find something else
